title: Organic Rye & Hemp Seeded Loaf
subtitle: Technical Baking Sheet
summary: A high-seed whole rye formulation built for nutrient density — hemp hearts, pumpkin and sunflower seeds, and ground flax carry magnesium, B6, tyrosine, and omega-3s. A pre-soak neutralizes phytic acid so those minerals stay bioavailable rather than bound.

Method is no-knead: a high-frequency stretch-and-fold schedule builds structure in a dough too slack to knead conventionally, followed by a 12–24 hour cold ferment for deep proteolysis and lactic acid development.

specs.label: Method
specs.value: No-knead / high-frequency stretch & fold / 24 hr cold proof

scalingPrinciple: Item A.01 (Organic Whole Rye Flour) is locked at 100.0% in the baker's convention. Every other component reads directly as a true baker's percentage against that 1,000 g flour mass, so the formula scales linearly to any batch size.

rows.name: Organic Whole Rye Flour
rows.role: Primary flour substrate; high pentosan content drives the hydration requirement.

rows.name: Vital Wheat Gluten
rows.role: Structural scaffold for gas retention — rye alone cannot form a gluten network.

rows.name: Water (Filtered)
rows.role: Optimal hydration for rye pentosans. 10–20% may be replaced with whole milk kefir.

rows.name: Hemp Hearts
rows.role: Tyrosine and magnesium; soft texture, no hard bite.

rows.name: Sunflower Seeds
rows.role: B6; cofactor for B12 and folate metabolism.

rows.name: Ground Flaxseed
rows.role: Omega-3 for membrane fluidity; also a mucilage binder.

matrixFootnote: Water may be substituted 10–20% with whole milk kefir for additional lactic tang and a softer crumb. Adjust total hydration only if the kefir is notably thicker than the water it replaces.

mise.label: Seed Soaker — T minus 2:00 hours (C.01–C.03)
mise.text: Combine hemp hearts, pumpkin seeds, and sunflower seeds with 150 g of the recipe water at 35–45°C. Rest 2 hours.

mise.label: Why the soaker matters
mise.text: Soaking neutralizes phytic acid to unlock the magnesium bound in the seeds, and pre-hydrates them so they do not pull water back out of the dough during bulk fermentation.

execution.name: Phase 2 — The Mix & Autolyse
execution.text: Whisk dry rye flour and vital wheat gluten thoroughly in a large bowl. Add the seed soaker including its liquid, salt, yeast, ground flax, and the remaining 670 g of water. Mix until a thick, shaggy paste forms with no dry flour remaining. Cover and let sit for 20 minutes.

execution.name: Phase 3 — High-Frequency Structural Build
items: **Fold 1 (20 min):** With wet hands, perform 4–6 folds by pulling the edge of the dough up and over the center.
**Fold 2 (40 min):** Perform 4 folds. The vital wheat gluten will begin providing noticeable resistance.
**Fold 3 (60 min):** Perform 4 folds. This ensures even distribution of the heavy seed inclusions.
**Fold 4 (80 min):** Final fold. Pull the dough into a tight, rounded mass.

execution.name: Phase 4 — Cold Fermentation
execution.text: Cover the container tightly to prevent a skin from forming and refrigerate for a minimum of 12 hours. This window allows deep proteolysis and lactic acid development, which maximizes the bioavailability of the B-vitamin cofactors and builds the sour backbone of the loaf.

execution.name: Phase 5 — Final Proof
execution.text: Remove the cold dough. Divide and shape gently into two logs using wet hands or a bench scraper. Place into greased loaf tins. Let rise until the dough reaches the rim of the tin.

execution.name: Phase 6 — The Bake
execution.text: Place a pan of water at the bottom of the oven for the first 15 minutes to generate steam. Bake to a target internal temperature of 98°C (208°F) — this is crucial for setting rye starches.

items.label: Why:
items.text: This setting period stabilizes the starches, resulting in a lower glycemic index and preventing the gummy texture that under-rested rye loaves develop.

sections.title: V. Serving Suggestions
items: Raw almond butter (no added sugar or palm oil), or mashed avocado.
1 tbsp tahini — sesame fats plus zinc.
1–2 tsp dark black miso — tyrosine and melanoidins.
1 tsp Chinese black vinegar — improves mineral solubility.

directive: Target internal temperature, not clock time, governs the bake. Rye starches set only at 98°C (208°F); pulling the loaf early produces a gummy, dense crumb that the 24-hour cure cannot fix.
